description: Challenge yourself and your friends in a fast-paced item hunting race!
body:
# **Item Speedrun Race**

Challenge yourself and your friends in a fast-paced item hunting race!

In this plugin, your goal is simple: find the target item as quickly as possible. Play solo to beat your personal best or compete against friends to see who can obtain the item first.

Perfect for speedrunning, multiplayer challenges, and random item races.

## **Features**
 - Random target item every round
 - Multiplayer and solo support
 - Fast and easy setup
 - Generate a completely new world for fresh challenges
 - Quickly reset rounds without restarting the server
 - Works as both a Mod and a Plugin

## **Commands**

**Command	Description**

**/start**	Starts a new item speedrun round

**/newround**	Clears the current round and resets everything

**/newworld**	Creates a brand-new world for a fresh challenge

## **How to Play**

Use /start to begin the challenge.
A target item will be selected.
Race to obtain the item before everyone else.
Start a new round or generate a new world whenever you want.

Can you become the fastest item hunter?
